metric_semantics.net_top_bucket_excess_return_pct: Mean cross-sectional top-bucket horizon excess return in percentage points minus heuristic average-turnover cost; not cumulative or annualized portfolio return.
metric_semantics.top_bucket_max_drawdown_pct: Diagnostic compounding of horizon labels at each rebalance; labels overlap when horizon_sessions exceeds rebalance_step_sessions (20 versus 10 in preregistration). Not drawdown of a tradable portfolio.
metric_semantics.variant_selection: No automatic best variant or promotion; descriptive measurements only.

paired_stability.interpretation: Previously exposed retrospective test. Overlapping horizon labels and shared training data mean dates and seeds are not independent replicates. Halves and leave-one-date-out ranges describe sensitivity, not confidence intervals, significance, or future validation.
paired_stability.cost_policy: Paired date diagnostics use gross excess only. Per-seed aggregate metrics retain the comparator average-turnover heuristic; no per-date net return is invented.
